candidates.rationale: membership count comes from complete selected household person membership; do not use unvalidated totals

INDEC CPV2022 P02 sex registered at birth: code 1 female, 2 male; EPH 2024 CH04 sex codes 1 male, 2 female. A mechanical value reversal is possible as an explicit binary proxy, but not a semantic equivalence of questionnaires. Only commissioning allowed.
CPV2022 P03 is gender identity, not age. CPV2022 EDAD is age at 18 May 2022; EPH CH06 is age at quarter interview. 2022 age can be used for source diagnostics, not transported as 2024 age.
2022 location of birth P13 potentially supports a birthplace country-group recode, but classification/recode unreviewed.
2010 literacy P07 is NOT 2022 P07, which records education level currently attended. No approved direct literacy equivalent.
2010 attendance status P08 is NOT 2022 P08 (current grade/year). Potential composition of attends P06 and past attendance P09 is unreviewed.
2010 highest education level P09 is NOT 2022 P09 (past attendance). 2022 current P07 and previous P10 need conditional harmonization.
2010 completion indicator P10 is NOT 2022 P10 (highest level previously attended). Candidate 2022 P11 needs universe recode.
2022 CONDACT codes 1 employed, 2 unemployed, 3 inactive, but universe and age/ref-period transport not established.
Same field code may have revised dwelling categories and universe; reject identity assumption until full labels compared.
Historical H05 floor material corresponds to 2022 H10 floor material; compare categories for 2022 new material labels.

April 2025 VP source catalog stores H11 (label: exterior roof material); current online 2022 dictionary uses combined H11_H12. Source-vintage category/universe equivalence must be established, including source code 99 (ignored).

April 2025 VP source stores H11 roof material (codes include 99), while current online uses combined H11_H12 roof+ceiling. Whether presence of interior ceiling is recoverable from April H11 requires source-specific official codes; not approved.
2010 H08 water distribution; 2022 H13 water availability; universes and codes require review.
2010 H09 water source; 2022 H14 water source for drinking/cooking; compare 2022 response options.

2010 H10 bathroom presence conflicts with 2022 H10 floor material. April 2025 VP has H15_17 inodoro discharge variable (not H15_H17) and H16 bathroom count; no automatic common representation without conditional recode.
2010 H11 toilet mechanism was rejected in historical policy. April 2025 VP uses H15_17; no promotion without independent source value comparison.
2010 H12 sewer/drainage; 2022 H18 toilet discharge; compare category meanings and availability.
DANGEROUS: 2010 H13 bathroom sharing; 2022 H13 water access; no direct bathroom-sharing field confirmed.
DANGEROUS: 2010 H14 cooking fuel; 2022 H14 drinking water source, 2022 H19 is fuel.

Historical EPH II2 / CPV2010 H15 number of sleeping rooms: the official CPV2022 VP dictionary does not list an H21 field. H20 is total rooms (not sleeping rooms); no direct equivalent for II2 established in this source.
DANGEROUS: 2010 H16 rooms total vs 2022 H16 number of bathrooms; 2022 H20 is rooms total.
2010 PROP dwelling/land tenure vs 2022 H22 dwelling ownership, categories require explicit mapping.

2022 P03 is gender identity, never age; age field is EDAD.
2022 P02 sex code order is reverse of EPH CH04.
2022 H10/H13/H14/H16 are concept collisions relative to 2010.
All mappings require source-specific response masks and universe review.
No sampled 2022 frame here represents the national population.
